segments.text:
V. 6.
They were not able to draw it, for the multitude of fiſhes—This was not only a Demonſtration of the Power of our LORD, but a kind Supply for them and their Families, and ſuch as might be of Service to them, when they waited afterward in Jeruſalem. It was likewiſe an Emblem of the great Succeſs which ſhould attend them as Fiſhers of men.
